bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$ROOT"
mask=0
for x in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_room_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
 if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- "$x"; then
  case "$x" in *resident_ipc.py) mask=$((mask+1));; *room_smoke.py) mask=$((mask+2));; *test_client.py) mask=$((mask+4));; esac
 fi
done
if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != 004757a1eeb5a847fd7adb7de5204f1575e4b3ba ]; then mask=$((mask+8)); fi
exit $((80+mask))
